packageRules.description: Released fixes for the dev tools the game relies on come in at once, as pnpm's minimumReleaseAgeExclude allows
Patch and minor updates merge themselves once CI passes; majors wait for a person
Below 1.0, a minor update may change the API (0.9 to 0.10), which the game's tests may not reach: a person merges it

Never merged without a person: the tools above come in on release day, before any wait could catch a hijacked release, and CI's engine job runs them with the Open Cloud key once a commit reaches main; and a Rojo update needs a check that CI can't make, that rbx-forge supports its Studio plugin
Wally's registry gives no release dates, so the two-week wait can't hold back a fresh release of a Roblox package: it shows up at once, and a person merges it

description: Updates for this game. Its CI runs the full check on each update, so an update merges only when the game still builds and passes its tests.

customManagers.description: The create-baseplate whose agent files (AGENTS.md, skills, hooks) the game keeps: .github/workflows/renovate-fixups.yml syncs them on the update's branch
The game's Roblox packages, pinned exactly in wally.toml (`React = "jsdotlua/react@=17.2.1"`): .github/workflows/renovate-fixups.yml writes wally.lock on the update's branch
